premise: A BCEG composition state exposes k Boolean boundary variables and proves the projected state solely by producing exact branch certificates for every boundary assignment.
cost_statement: If discovery/verification/representation cost per branch is bounded by poly(n), exhaustive Boolean boundary composition costs O(2^k poly(n)) before additional shared-DAG savings. Therefore this mechanism is polynomial for k=O(log n). No claim is made that arbitrary CNF admits such a k or that every BCEG language must enumerate assignments.
proof_sketch: There are exactly 2^k total assignments to k Boolean boundary variables.
An exhaustive assignment-based composition examines/certifies at most one branch per assignment.
Multiplying 2^k branches by a polynomial per-branch bound gives O(2^k poly(n)).
If k <= c log_2 n, then 2^k <= n^c and the product is polynomial.
open_escape_routes: Prove a universal polynomially discoverable cut with k=O(log n).
Find an exact symbolic boundary message representing exponentially many assignments compactly and prove polynomial discovery/join/canonicalization bounds.
Exploit algebraic/counting/Horn structure across the boundary without truth-table enumeration.
forbidden_inference: This lemma neither proves an exponential lower bound for all BCEG algorithms nor establishes P != NP. It only characterizes the current exhaustive Boolean-boundary composition mechanism.
